generator_cmd: printf %s "$plain" | iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-16LE | xxd -p -c1 | tac | tr -d '\n' | tr a-f A-F | awk '{print "obase=8; ibase=16; " $0}' | BC_LINE_LENGTH=0 bc  # iconv UTF-16LE, bytes reversed (int.from_bytes little), GNU bc -> octal
oracle_cmd: printf %s "$encoded" | python3 -I -c "import sys;n=int(sys.stdin.read().strip(),8);print(n.to_bytes((n.bit_length()+15)//16*2,'little').decode('utf-16-le'))"  # stdlib int.to_bytes little, padded to whole UTF-16 units, + UTF-16LE
